messages.subject: add resource
parts:
I am receiving an error message I don't understand when trying to use the 'schedule' function in the add_resource function

> AirAmbulance_c %>% 
     add_resource("helicopter_shift_d", schedule(c(8, 16, 24), c(3, 2, 1), period=24)) %>%               add_generator("Call out", incident2, function() {c(0, rpois(99, 1.5), -1)}) 
Error: resource 'helicopter_shift_d' was defined, but no schedule was attached In addition: Warning messages: 1: In add_resource_(.env$sim_obj, i, positive(capacity), positive(queue_size), : resource 'helicopter_shift_d' already defined 2: In add_resource_manager_(.env$sim_obj, i, "capacity", positive(capacity), : process 'helicopter_shift_d_capacity' already defined

First it says that no schedule was attached and then that 'helicopter_shift_d_capacity is already defined

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] add resource
parts:
On Fri, 30 Jul 2021 at 05:26, martin wall <marti...@health.govt.nz> wrote:
I am receiving an error message I don't understand when trying to use the 'schedule' function in the add_resource function

> AirAmbulance_c %>% 
     add_resource("helicopter_shift_d", schedule(c(8, 16, 24), c(3, 2, 1), period=24)) %>%               add_generator("Call out", incident2, function() {c(0, rpois(99, 1.5), -1)}) 
Error: resource 'helicopter_shift_d' was defined, but no schedule was attached In addition: Warning messages: 1: In add_resource_(.env$sim_obj, i, positive(capacity), positive(queue_size), : resource 'helicopter_shift_d' already defined 2: In add_resource_manager_(.env$sim_obj, i, "capacity", positive(capacity), : process 'helicopter_shift_d_capacity' already defined

First it says that no schedule was attached and then that 'helicopter_shift_d_capacity is already defined

TL;DR, your simulation environment, at that point, already has a helicopter_shift_d resource defined. This usually happens when you are trying things interactively and you didn't clear the simulation environment properly. This is what happens:
  1. We try to add a resource, but it already exists -> generates a warning.
  2. We try to add the schedule, but it already exists -> generates a warning.
  3. The schedule didn't succeed -> generates the error.
We could in theory avoid the last error, but we need protection against other kind of errors that could leave a resource without capacity defined.

--
Iñaki Úcar

Thanks for your reply

What I am trying to do is run the simulation using lapply with different seeds so that I get a number of results. So the add_resource function is within the lapply function. Presumably the second time it runs through the loop the helicopter_shift_d resource already exists. I can't put the add resource outside the loop as the demand generator is random so it needs to use the new seed for that iteration. So I guess I would have to either i. clear the resource allocation at each iteration or ii add the resources (the helicopter shift) outside the loop and the random demand generation within the loop. Can either of them be done?   Thanks again for your help

Martin

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] add resource
parts:
The simplest way is to instantiate a new simulator for each iteration. I tend to encapsulate the whole simulation in a simulate() function, and then run lapply for different seeds and/or different parameters. This is how it is done in [1], and discussed in [2]. But if the simulation model is huge (many resources, sources, trajectories...) and the time to instantiate it is a concern, then you can do this once and then reset() it for each iteration.

[1] https://r-simmer.org/articles/simmer-aa-5g
[2] https://github.com/r-simmer/simmer/discussions/244
[3] https://r-simmer.org/reference/reset.html
